name: TypingIndicator
description: Adds an indicator if someone is typing on a channel.

settings.label: Include current channel
settings.description: Whether to show the typing indicator for the currently selected channel

settings.label: Include muted channels
settings.description: Whether to show the typing indicator for muted channels.

settings.label: Include ignored users
settings.description: Whether to show the typing indicator for ignored users.

settings.label: Include blocked users
settings.description: Whether to show the typing indicator for blocked users.

settings.label: Indicator mode
settings.description: How should the indicator be displayed?

notes: Channels, voice channels' chats and threads in the channel list show who is typing in them: up to three avatars (then "+N") and Discord's animated dots, with "Ava is typing..." as the tooltip. Names are the server nickname, display name or username, as upstream.
gaps: Only the account you are viewing: Qord tracks typing for the current account
With more than three typers the tooltip says "Several people are typing..." (upstream names two when TypingTweaks, not ported yet, is on)
Clicking the avatars doesn't open user popouts
